faq.headline: E-Commerce FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common Questions Answered
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our e-commerce development services and how we can help grow your online business.

items.question: Which e-commerce platform is best for my business?
items.answer: The ideal platform depends on your scale, budget, and requirements. We typically recommend Shopify for fast launches, WooCommerce for content-heavy stores, and custom headless solutions for high-traffic brands needing maximum flexibility and performance.

items.question: Can you migrate my existing store to a new platform?
items.answer: Yes, we handle full-service migrations including product data, customer accounts, order history, and SEO redirects. We ensure zero downtime during the transition and verify all data integrity post-migration.

items.question: Do you support headless commerce architectures?
items.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in headless builds using NextJS as the frontend with Shopify, Medusa, or custom backends. This gives you maximum control over the shopping experience with best-in-class performance.

items.question: What payment methods can you integrate?
items.answer: We integrate all major payment processors including Stripe, PayPal, Square, and Authorize.net. We also support Apple Pay, Google Pay, buy-now-pay-later services like Klarna, and cryptocurrency payments.

items.question: How do you ensure PCI compliance?
items.answer: We use tokenized payment processing through certified gateways, never storing card data on your servers. We implement SSL encryption, secure authentication, and conduct regular security audits to maintain full PCI DSS compliance.

items.question: Can you set up international payments and multi-currency?
items.answer: Yes, we configure multi-currency storefronts with automatic exchange rate updates, localized pricing, and region-specific payment methods to maximize global conversion rates.

items.question: How do you optimize conversion rates?
items.answer: We use data-driven A/B testing, heatmap analysis, and funnel optimization to continuously improve your store. Common wins include streamlined checkout flows, better product photography layouts, and personalized recommendations.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
items.answer: Yes, we provide monthly retainer plans that include performance monitoring, bug fixes, feature enhancements, conversion optimization, and regular security updates to keep your store running smoothly.

items.question: Can you integrate with my existing ERP or CRM?
items.answer: We build custom integrations with popular ERPs like SAP, NetSuite, and Odoo, as well as CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. We ensure bi-directional data sync for orders, inventory, and customer records.
